scope: short-side R3 base-only 2024 chronological probe; no HPO, calibration, residual, consensus, policy, portfolio, or live-execution change

contract.entry: exact 1-minute open at signal close +1 hour
contract.label: H12 TP +6 ATR / SL -4 ATR; adverse same-minute tie; R3 adverse=0, weak=1, robust_clear=2 with cost+25-bps robust-clear hurdle and 50-bps softness
contract.cost: 100 bps is applied once: net_bps = gross_bps - 100
contract.model: frozen long base HPO only: 140 trees, learning rate 0.05, 31 leaves, minimum child 350, feature/subsample 0.8, L2 8; no short HPO
contract.feature_contract: short base_fields_by_side.short (120 requested); target-free Jan-Mar 90%-coverage gate retained 48 fields; all medians fit on resolved training rows only

causality_and_parity.target_free_features: The short 120-field feature panel was generated before joining any labels from the full point-in-time market universe.
causality_and_parity.label_substrate: For every month, short candidate validity, exact entry price, and causal ATR are byte-for-byte identical to the frozen long 2024 label substrate. Only directional path outcomes are rematerialised for short from exact one-minute high/low/close.
causality_and_parity.invalid_handling: Invalid/incomplete paths have target_invalid=true and null economic/R3 targets; they are excluded from fit and metrics, not encoded as failures.
causality_and_parity.cross_side_audit: All six 2024 months passed identity, label-validity, exact-entry, ATR, and gross-minus-cost parity checks.
causality_and_parity.oos_boundary: The final 102 June 23:00 signal rows are outside the scored decision window because their decision timestamp is 2024-07-01; they were not silently included.

validation.r3_reconstruction: Verified against the long artifact: all valid rows map to canonical class order adverse=0, weak=1, robust_clear=2.
validation.duplicate_shared_atr_march: Independent March shared-ATR materialisations have identical IDs and zero numerical delta.
validation.final_label_support: Jan 31,753; Feb 30,906; Mar 34,735; Apr 32,302; May 34,387; Jun 38,071 exact valid short labels.
validation.final_oos_support: 104,706 valid exact labels; 371,110 target-free rows scored before outcome metrics.
validation.superseded_outputs: v1 used an outcome-conditioned feature coverage screen; v2 repaired that screen but used generic Apr-Jun ATR warm-up semantics rather than the frozen long substrate. Both are retained for audit but are not results. v3 is authoritative.

live_effect: None. This probe has no model-bundle, execution, exchange, or promotion authority.
